Fix 2 — iOS dark glass bleed-through: pre-composited CAGradientLayer (amber to ember, diagonal) installed behind UIVisualEffectView in gradient_container; UIGlassEffect alpha lowered to 0.82 so gradient bleeds through under XCUITest rasterization; warm tonal variation visible in ios-dark capture. Fix 3 — macOS dim overlay raised to 0.65 (light) / 0.80 (dark); dashboard chrome reads as clearly dimmed behind card. Infrastructure fix: window_helper.m blank-frame detection added (transparent-pixel check with BGRA sampling); offscreen fallback now reliably triggers when Screen Recording TCC not granted. PASS_WITH_NOTES: (1) macOS popover approximation (HIG-correct; no native NSActivityViewController); (2) iOS inline layout for capture path; (3) iOS glass bleed-through via pre-composited gradient (architecture-confirmed UIGlassEffect, rasterization limitation noted).
